meta_title: Rapid Entry Locksmith | Emergency Locksmith Nottingham
meta_description: Rapid Entry Locksmith in Nottingham provides 24/7 emergency lockouts, lock repairs and installations. Fast response, fair pricing. Call now.
hero_subhead: We arrive within 30 minutes, any time of day or night. No call-out charge if we can't help.
services_subhead: From urgent lockouts to security upgrades, we handle all locksmith needs with speed and professionalism.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home or business? We're on the road within 30 minutes to get you back inside, with no damage to your doors or locks.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, stiff mechanisms, or worn keys? We repair or replace any domestic or commercial lock, often while you wait.

services.title: Burglary Repairs
services.desc: Forced entry damaged your door frame or lock? We secure the damage with sturdy replacement locks and reinforce vulnerable entry points.

services.title: UPVC Door & Window Locks
services.desc: Specialising in uPVC mechanism repairs and replacements. We fix broken handles, cylinders, and multi-point locks without replacing the whole door.

services.title: Lock Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade to anti-snap cylinders, mortice deadlocks, or smart locks. We advise on the best security solution for your property and install same day.

services.title: Safe Opening & Maintenance
services.desc: Locked out of a safe or need regular maintenance? We open jammed safes and service locking mechanisms to keep them reliable.

about_pullquote: I started this because Nottingham deserves a locksmith who answers the phone at 2am.
about_para_1: Rapid Entry Locksmith was born from frustration — too many Nottingham residents left stranded outside their homes with no one answering the phone. We run a tight, fast operation: we're here 24/7, we arrive quickly, and we charge fairly. In the past 6 years, we've resolved over 1,000 lockouts and built a reputation for turning up on time, every time.
about_para_2: We're not a franchise or a call centre routing your job to the cheapest contractor. You get the same locksmith who answered your call. That's why families and businesses keep our number saved and recommend us to their neighbours. We're Nottingham-based, know the city inside out, and take pride in solving your problem without fuss.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening and panicked. Called Rapid Entry and the locksmith was here in 20 minutes. Sorted it without damaging anything and charged a fair price. Absolute lifesaver. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David R.

reviews.text: Had a break-in attempt on my flat. Called them at midnight expecting to wait hours. They arrived in 25 minutes, fitted new locks and made the place feel secure again. Professional, quick, and didn't overcharge. Really impressed.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: uPVC door lock jammed completely and I was stuck outside with two kids. Got through immediately, no waiting in a queue, and they came straight away. Fixed it in 15 minutes. Can't ask for better service than that.
reviews.author: Claire M.
